limitations: A-S008 alone is not B-S008 native proof, D-S008 completion, or source S008 completion.
Parent prerequisites D-S003, D-S051, D-S052, and D-S056 are preserved; the A slice itself enters through SOURCE.
No native Azure routing, authorization, tenant isolation, capacity, drain, rollback, latency, or shared-dependency behavior was validated.
No 99.999% proof, uptime SLA, statistical reliability result, or production-success guarantee.
Only eight fictional members and deterministic bounded fixtures are exercised; the 120-second window is not a real observation period.
IaC and deployment are N/A for this SOURCE lesson, not approved for a live harness.
Browser focus pixel rounding required a less brittle assertion; native file Resource Timing entries were unavailable, so loaded local DOM/CSSOM assets and request events were checked instead.
Independent acceptance and publication references belong to the controller result after this evidence is committed; no self-referential eventual commit SHA is embedded.

The completed deployment lifecycle is an explicit fictional prerequisite, not a deployment command or observed Azure lifecycle. Its running/unknown variants are model fixtures, not a second cloud simulator.

Supplemental invalid browser inputs were injected into local native controls for negative testing; ordinary lesson choices remain the declared fixtures. HTTP(S) observations cover this owned page, not unrelated browser traffic.
